subject: Request: Promo credit + 30-day trial extension for AcmeOps pilot
content:
From: Sabrina Lopez <sabrina@acmeops.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21 09:14:00 -0000
Subject: Request: Promo credit + 30-day trial extension for AcmeOps pilot

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the fast kickoff last week. The pilot got delayed on our side while we completed a security review; we were only able to start ingesting data yesterday. Given the lost time, can Redwood provide a one-time promo credit equal to the unused portion of our trial (roughly $12,500) and a 30-day extension to our sandbox trial so we can finish the evaluation? Our procurement team also asked for any accounting documentation we can share (credit memo or invoice offset language) to pass to our AP team.

I've attached a short note from our finance team outlining the ask. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sabrina Lopez
Head of Platform, AcmeOps
Sabrina Lopez | AcmeOps

Attachment: acmeops_credit_request.pdf (1 page, pdf)

-----
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Sabrina Lopez <sabrina@acmeops.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21 10:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: Promo credit + 30-day trial extension for AcmeOps pilot

Hi Sabrina — thanks for the context and the note. Apologies for the kick-off delay on your side; we want to make sure you get a full opportunity to evaluate.

Proposed plan on our end:
- Sales approves a one-time promo credit to offset outstanding trial usage up to $12,500.
- We issue a credit memo that net against the next invoice (or can be exported as a standalone credit memo for your AP).
- Provide a 30-day sandbox extension tied to the same account (no additional billing during the extension).

I'll need signoff from Finance for the ledger posting and correct GLA mapping. Looping in Aditya for deal context and Laura in Finance for accounting confirmation.

Next step: Laura — can you confirm the preferred accounting treatment (credit memo vs. contra entry) and the GL mapping that AcmeOps should see on their AP? Also, are there any internal limits we need to route for approvals?

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

-----
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21 11:23:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: Promo credit + 30-day trial extension for AcmeOps pilot

Tessa / Aditya —

Finance notes below for audit trail and GL treatment. Summary: we can issue a customer credit memo for $12,500 to clear the promo. Accounting treatment options and recommended approach:

1) Credit memo applied to AR (preferred): Issue a credit memo referencing the original invoice(s) or the upcoming invoice. GLA impact: reduce Accounts Receivable (AR) and post contra-revenue to promo_allowance (G/L 6102). This preserves gross revenue and shows allowance separately for disclosure.

2) Contra offset (not preferred): Post journal entry to write off a portion of revenue and reduce AR without issuing a formal credit memo. This makes AP reconciliation slightly harder on the customer side.

Given this is a customer-facing request and AcmeOps's AP wants documentation, we should issue a formal credit memo. Please confirm:
- Exact credit amount (to the dollar) we should record.
- Any invoice numbers to reference (if there were prior invoices).
- Whether AcmeOps prefers a standalone credit memo PDF or the credit applied directly to a specific invoice.

If you confirm $12,500 and that they want a standalone document, we will prepare the credit memo and send to Sabrina + AcmeOps Finance. Also recommend adding a short narrative on the memo: "One-time promotional credit due to pilot execution delay; no cash impact."

Marcus — FYI for JE posting and month-end.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Finance | Redwood Inference

-----
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21 12:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: Promo credit + 30-day trial extension for AcmeOps pilot

Agree with Laura. A couple of operational notes for the credit memo issuance and JE:

- Use contra-revenue account code 6102 (promo_allowance) for posting; post AR reduction to 1200-AR.
- For the memo reference, if there is no invoice we should reference the HubSpot deal ID (RDW-3479) and the pilot start date. That makes audit mapping cleaner.
- If the customer wants a refund instead of credit, we'd need an approval from Finance leadership (not applicable here).
- We should attach the credit memo draft and a one-paragraph narrative for the customer's AP to upload to their ERP.

I'll create the draft JE and drop into the billing queue once Laura signs off on the language.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

-----
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21 14:07:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: Promo credit + 30-day trial extension for AcmeOps pilot

All — I approve the $12,500 one-time promo credit for the AcmeOps pilot given the delay. Please issue the credit memo and extend the sandbox for 30 days effective today.

Quick asks:
- Tessa, please send Sabrina the draft credit memo PDF and cc Finance so their AP has the documentation.
- Laura / Marcus, please confirm posting timeline (we need this done before month-end close).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Sabrina — great news: Sales has approved the one-time $12,500 promotional credit and we've queued Finance to issue a formal credit memo. I've attached the draft for your review and will finalize language per your preference. The sandbox account will be extended by 30 days starting today; no additional charges during that period.

Attached: credit_memo_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet with memo fields)

Laura / Marcus — please proceed with issuing the finalized PDF credit memo and JE posting. We need the memo sent to finance@acmeops.com and e-signed record stored in our billing folder.

Sabrina — let me know if you prefer the credit applied to a future invoice or a standalone memo; we'll deliver whichever is easiest for your AP.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
